scope: 60 successful warm keyboard source replacements across twelve one-page template/paper variants in the exact unchanged local packaged app. The profiler is a new developer tool identified by its hash; no production application input changes. This is separate from the still-running full hosted Mac qualification.
measurementLimits: A fresh isolated app profile is prepared before timing. Each variant is compiled once before its measured edits; these are warm builds, not cold-cache samples.
All cases share one app/runtime/engine-cache session. OS caches are not purged; case order and every sample are retained.
Input and DOM timing use one renderer performance clock. Two animation frames after current text and Up to date are a rendering opportunity, not a physical display measurement.
Native IPC timing includes validation, assets, compiler and history checkpoint. Compiler duration is the production rounded field, not TeX-only time.
The harness temporarily wraps the existing private Electron IPC handler, preserving its event, arguments, result and errors. This is version-sensitive instrumentation, not a production API.
Renderer timer/frame gaps are observations under automation, not proof of typing latency, OS CPU/memory quotas or full app resource budgets.
Empirical percentiles describe this finite ordered corpus on one development Mac; they are not population p95 or acceptance on every supported device/OS.

warmTarget.criterion: Observed empirical 95th percentile below 3000 ms from displayed automatic-compilation start to the current PDF plus two renderer frames.
warmTarget.scope: One development M4 Pro, five ordered samples per variant, 1480 x 960 logical viewport and devicePixelRatio 1. Not population p95 or all supported-device acceptance.

harnessDevelopment.initialFailure: Initial smoke compiled and rendered the edit but stopped because pdftotext was absent. The final harness preflights the existing pypdf environment before launching; the final smoke and full run both pass without installing tools or changing app/runtime bytes.

remaining: Fresh/prepared editing-startup pairs for this current package.
